title: Graphite: free Adobe Illustrator alternative
caption:
Adobe Illustrator charges $22.99/month. Graphite draws vector art for free 🎨

✅ Vector editing with layers, in your browser
✅ Zoom in forever and export at any resolution
✅ Nondestructive: change a slider instead of redrawing
✅ No subscription, 100% free

ℹ️ Graphite is still in alpha, so expect rough edges. The web app is live now; desktop apps are still in testing
💻 Any browser

Comment "ART" and I'll DM you the link 🔗

Follow @itsongit for a new free open-source find every day
